headline: IRGC Missiles Strike Six Vessels in Hormuz as U.S. Deploys Tankers
subheadline: Three KC-46A tankers launched from Fairchild AFB as CENTCOM confirms attack on aircraft carrier and destroyer with no casualties reported.
lede: Iran's IRGC launched missile attacks on six vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, including three oil tankers and three U.S. ships, marking a major escalation. The U.S. responded by deploying three KC-46A tankers from Fairchild AFB, while CENTCOM confirmed the attack on a U.S. aircraft carrier and guided-missile destroyer with no American personnel harmed. Admiral Brad Cooper warned that further IRGC attacks would trigger strikes on three Iranian ships. In parallel, the IDF conducted operations in Gaza and Lebanon amid reports of rockets toward the Golan Heights.

sections.title: Putin Meets U.S. Envoys Amid Continued Strikes
sections.body: Putin met with U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow for over three hours to discuss potential conflict resolution paths. Russia announced a three-day pause on strikes against Kyiv starting midnight September 5, linked to U.S. envoy visits. Despite the declared ceasefire, Ukrainian military stated combat operations continue and 'Bandery' loitering munitions were tracked moving from Sumy and Chernihiv regions toward Kyiv. Russian forces struck vehicle parking lots in Zaporizhzhia and Pavlograd, destroying all transport present, while a family in Chuguyev was killed and a 40-year-old woman was injured.

sections.title: IRGC Missiles Strike Six Hormuz Vessels
sections.body: Iran's IRGC launched missile attacks on six vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, including three oil tankers traveling illegally and three American vessels. The U.S. Air Force deployed three KC-46A tankers from Fairchild AFB with sequential callsigns indicating outbound movement. CENTCOM confirmed Iran attacked a U.S. aircraft carrier and guided-missile destroyer, stating no American personnel were harmed, while Admiral Brad Cooper warned of strikes on three Iranian ships. Explosions were heard in Qeshm and Jask, with IDF operations continuing in Gaza and Lebanon.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Strait of Hormuz remains the primary threat vector with Iran's IRGC having launched missile attacks on six vessels including three U.S. ships, while the U.S. has deployed KC-46A tankers and Admiral Cooper warned of strikes on Iranian ships. In Ukraine, diplomatic engagement between Russia and the United States proceeds alongside ongoing kinetic operations, with Russian 'Bandery' loitering munitions actively deployed toward Kyiv and cross-border drone activity persisting from multiple directions.
